definitions.explanation: Two things that form a matching set or are meant to go together.
Used to indicate opposition or comparison between two sides, as in sports scores or matchups.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{対|たい}ブラジルの{試合|しあい}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched the Japan vs. Brazil match.

examples.japanese: この{花瓶|かびん}は{一対|いっつい}で{売|う}られている。
examples.english: These vases are sold as a pair.

examples.japanese: {一対|いっつい}の{イヤリング}。
A{対|たい}Bの{対戦|たいせん}。
examples.english: A match between A and B.

examples.japanese: {一対|いっつい}の{燭台|しょくだい}。
{チャンピオン}{対|たい}{挑戦者|ちょうせんしゃ}。
{対|つい}になっている{置物|おきもの}。
{与党|よとう}{対|たい}{野党|やとう}。
{神社|じんじゃ}の{入|い}り{口|ぐち}に{一対|いっつい}の{狛犬|こまいぬ}が{置|お}かれている。
examples.english: A pair of guardian dogs is placed at the entrance of the shrine.

notes:
{対|たい} has two main uses: "versus/against" and "pair/set." The reading changes depending on meaning.

READINGS:
- たい: "versus" meaning, used in compounds ({対策|たいさく}, {対象|たいしょう})
- つい: "pair" meaning ({一対|いっつい}の{花瓶|かびん})

VERSUS USAGE:
- A{対|たい}B: A versus B (sports, debates, competitions)
- N{対|たい}N: score format (3{対|たい}2 = 3 to 2)
- Common in sports broadcasts and news

PAIR USAGE:
- {一対|いっつい}の〜: a pair of ~
- {対|つい}になっている: forming a pair

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {対策|たいさく}: countermeasure
- {対象|たいしょう}: target, object
- {反対|はんたい}: opposite, opposition
- {対応|たいおう}: response, correspondence
- {対立|たいりつ}: opposition, confrontation
